title: On the well-posedness and long-time dynamics of a discrete coagulation--annihilation system
summary: The present article investigates the well--posedness of a discrete coagulation--annihilation model originally introduced by E. Ben-Naim and P. Krapivsky in Physical Review E (1995). We first establish the existence of solutions for a broad class of coagulation and annihilation rates, including rates that may be unbounded. These results are obtained by combining uniform estimates with Helly's selection theorem and the Rellich--Kondrachov compact embedding theorem.
